summary_en: Curated collection of 3D work spanning product visualization, interior scenes, and abstract explorations.
summary_pt: Coleção curada de trabalho 3D abrangendo visualização de produto, cenas de interior e explorações abstratas.
challenge_en: Demonstrate versatility across different 3D disciplines while maintaining a cohesive aesthetic.
challenge_pt: Demonstrar versatilidade em diferentes disciplinas 3D mantendo uma estética coesa.
approach_en: Focus on clean lighting, material accuracy, and composition. Each piece explores different techniques while adhering to minimal aesthetic principles.
approach_pt: Foco em iluminação limpa, precisão de materiais e composição. Cada peça explora técnicas diferentes aderindo a princípios estéticos minimalistas.
outcome_en: Portfolio of high-quality renders showcasing technical skill and artistic vision.
outcome_pt: Portfolio de renders de alta qualidade mostrando habilidade técnica e visão artística.
body_en:
## Product Visualization

Clean, studio-lit product renders emphasizing form, materials, and details. Focus on photorealistic lighting and texture work.

## Interior Scenes

Architectural visualization exploring space, light, and atmosphere. Emphasis on mood and material believability.

## Abstract Explorations

Experimental work pushing technical and artistic boundaries. Playing with procedural materials, physics simulations, and non-representational forms.
